comment: QUESTS.md E12, PIP-4 The Elegy. The fingerpost's card with Piper; the eleven interviews across Little Gore, Sump and Fenmarch, two of them carrying other quests' afterwards pages; a dismissed Piper's errand waiting; the nine lines, not performed, and a bit more of a tune; afterwards for everybody and every owner back to their own page.
